conditions.condition: UE in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED initiates Initial Registration (Reasons: 5GS services, emergency, SMS over NAS, GERAN/UTRAN->NG-RAN mobility, SNPN onboarding, disaster roaming, resume after unavailability)
conditions.operation: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST, Start T3510, Stop T3502/T3511 (if running)

sub_conditions.operation: Waiting
Process REGISTRATION ACCEPT, Reset registration attempt counter, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED, Set 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED, Store TAI list etc.

sub_conditions.condition: Check if REGISTRATION COMPLETE is Required (based on IEs in ACCEPT: e.g., 5G-GUTI, SOR, Operator-defined AC, NSSAI updates, CAG info, PEIPS, UE Radio Cap ID, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI, Service-level-AA pending)
sub_conditions.operation: Decision Point
Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE
Network Stops T3550, Enters 5GMM-REGISTERED (Network Side)

sub_conditions.condition: Transmission Failure of REGISTRATION COMPLETE (No TAI Change)
sub_conditions.operation: Re-run sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE (UE Implementation)

sub_conditions.condition: Transmission Failure of REGISTRATION COMPLETE (TAI Change, TAI not in list)
sub_conditions.operation: Abort Initial Registration, Initiate Mobility Registration Update

sub_conditions.condition: Transmission Failure of REGISTRATION COMPLETE (TAI Change, TAI in list)
sub_conditions.operation: Resend REGISTRATION COMPLETE
Complete Registration Procedure (UE Side)
Process REGISTRATION REJECT
Decision based on Cause Value
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Consider USIM invalid (start T3245), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Add PLMN to Forbidden PLMN list (start T3245), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete TAI list, Add TAI to Forbidden TAI list (regional), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete TAI list, Add TAI to Forbidden TAI list (roaming), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or PLMN-SEARCH

Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete TAI list, Add TAI to Forbidden TAI list (roaming), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE, Search suitable cell in another TA. Handle potential Satellite/RAT restrictions.
Abort procedure, Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Start T3346, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Disable N1 mode capability, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Disable N1 (3GPP), Enable E-UTRA, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
Abort procedure, Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Store rejected NSSAI, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH (based on remaining slice availability)
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context (non-3GPP specific), Disable N1 (non-3GPP), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Add PLMN to Forbidden PLMN list, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH (3GPP) or LIMITED-SERVICE (non-3GPP)

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #74 (Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN)
sub_conditions.operation: Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Add SNPN to Temporary Forbidden SNPN list, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH (3GPP) or LIMITED-SERVICE (non-3GPP)

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #75 (Permanently not authorized for this SNPN)
sub_conditions.operation: Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Add SNPN to Permanent Forbidden SNPN list, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH (3GPP) or LIMITED-SERVICE (non-3GPP)

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #76 (Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only)
sub_conditions.operation: Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Update/Store CAG info, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or PLMN-SEARCH based on CAG rules

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #78 (PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location)
sub_conditions.operation: Set 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, Delete context, Add PLMN+location to Forbidden list (start timer), Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
Abort procedure, Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH, Avoid sending UAS info on retry

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #80 (Disaster roaming for the determined PLMN not allowed)
sub_conditions.operation: Abort procedure, Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Delete context, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH, Block disaster roaming retry for a period

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #81 (Selected N3IWF not compatible with allowed NSSAI)
sub_conditions.operation: Abort procedure, Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH, Optionally use provided N3IWF info for retry

sub_conditions.condition: Cause #82 (Selected TNGF not compatible with allowed NSSAI)
sub_conditions.operation: Abort procedure, Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH, Optionally use provided TNAN info for retry

sub_conditions.condition: Other Abnormal Cause (e.g., #95, #96, #97, #99, #111) or specific causes treated as abnormal
sub_conditions.operation: Stop T3510, Increment/Check Attempt Counter
Abort Procedure, Stop T3510, Increment/Check Attempt Counter

sub_conditions.condition: Lower Layer Failure or Release before ACCEPT/REJECT
sub_conditions.operation: Abort Procedure, Stop T3510, Increment/Check Attempt Counter
Abort and Re-initiate Initial Registration Procedure

sub_conditions.condition: Change in Current TAI before procedure completion
sub_conditions.operation: Abort and Re-initiate Initial Registration Procedure
Abort Initial Registration, Perform UE-initiated De-registration

conditions.condition: Handle Attempt Counter after Failure/Timeout (Common Logic for a1b1t, a1c, a1d)

sub_conditions.operation: Start T3511, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
Delete Context (TAI list, 5G-GUTI etc.), Start T3502 (if > 0), Set 5U2 NOT UPDATED, Enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH

edges.condition: Transmission Failure (TAI Change, TAI not in list)
Transmission Failure (TAI Change, TAI in list)
